					66 container
						67 text The HTTP 
						68 text 418 I'm a teapot
						69 text  status response code indicates that the server refuses to brew coffee because it is, permanently, a teapot. A combined coffee/tea pot that is temporarily out of coffee should instead return 
						70 link 503, Value: developer.mozilla.org/en-US/d…
						71 text . This error is a reference to Hyper Text Coffee Pot Control Protocol defined in April Fools' jokes in 1998 and 2014. While originally defined in 
						72 link RFC 2324 (external), Help: External link (opens in new tab), Value: rfc-editor.org/info/rfc2324/
						73 text  as an April Fools' joke, this status code was formally reserved in 
						74 link RFC 9110 (external), Help: External link (opens in new tab), Value: rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9110/
						75 text  due to its wide deployment as a joke, so it cannot be assigned any non-joke semantics for the foreseeable future. Some websites use this response for requests they do not wish to handle, such as automated queries.
